headword: {配達証明|はいたつしょうめい}

definitions.gloss: proof of delivery; delivery certification; certified delivery
definitions.explanation: A postal service that provides the sender with official proof that a letter or package was delivered to the recipient. In Japan, this is a service offered by Japan Post for registered mail.

examples.japanese: {大事|だいじ}な{書類|しょるい}なので{配達証明|はいたつしょうめい}で{送|おく}った。
examples.english: Since it was an important document, I sent it with proof of delivery.

examples.japanese: {配達証明|はいたつしょうめい}をつけると、{届|とど}いた{日時|にちじ}が{記録|きろく}される。
examples.english: When you add delivery certification, the date and time of delivery are recorded.

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}{解除|かいじょ}の{通知|つうち}は、{内容証明|ないようしょうめい}{郵便|ゆうびん}に{配達証明|はいたつしょうめい}をつけて{送|おく}るのが{一般的|いっぱんてき}だ。
examples.english: It is common to send a contract cancellation notice by certified content mail with delivery certification.

notes:
A compound of {配達|はいたつ} (delivery) and {証明|しょうめい} (proof, certification). Refers to a Japan Post service that provides the sender with a postcard confirming when the item was delivered.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配達証明|はいたつしょうめい}をつける — to add delivery certification
- {配達証明|はいたつしょうめい}で{送|おく}る — to send with proof of delivery
- {配達証明|はいたつしょうめい}{郵便|ゆうびん} — certified delivery mail
- {配達証明|はいたつしょうめい}{付|つ}き — with delivery certification attached

RELATED TERMS:
- {書留|かきとめ} — registered mail (tracked and insured; {配達証明|はいたつしょうめい} is an add-on to this)
- {内容証明|ないようしょうめい} — certified content mail (certifies what was written in the letter; often combined with {配達証明|はいたつしょうめい})
- {速達|そくたつ} — express delivery
- {普通郵便|ふつうゆうびん} — regular mail

PRACTICAL NOTE:
{配達証明|はいたつしょうめい} is commonly used for legal or official correspondence where the sender needs proof that a document was received. Typical uses include contract termination notices, demand letters, and formal complaints. It must be combined with {書留|かきとめ} (registered mail) and cannot be used alone.
